{{Top|leg}}
'''''Juble''''' were a pair of [[Cargo ferry|Cargo ferries]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

The ferries were trying to escape an attack by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Lightning (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Lighting'']] onto an Alliance [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] base consisting of 3 [[Class-A cargo container]]s ''[[Retuna]]'', ''[[Reyve]]'' and ''[[Garble]]'', multiple starfighters used by the Rebels, a single [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|transport]] ''[[Trole]]'' and two tugs ''[[Toone]]''. The base was destroyed and the ferries carrying the crew of the base were also destroyed before they could escape.
